checks.definition:

columns:

  checks:
  - qualifier: strict

checks.name: Metric function meets threshold
checks.definition:
filter: status <> 'cancelled'
columns:
- name: amount
  checks:
  - function: avg
    threshold:
      must_be_between:
        greater_than: 0
        less_than: 1000

checks.name: No invalid values
checks.definition:
filter: status <> 'cancelled'
columns:
- name: country
  checks:
  - attributes:
      owner: geo

checks.name: Row count meets expected threshold
checks.definition:
filter: status <> 'cancelled'
checks:
- qualifier: 2
  threshold:
    must_be_greater_than: 1

checks.name: Data is fresh
checks.definition:
filter: status <> 'cancelled'
checks:
- column: updated_at
  threshold:
    unit: hour
    must_be_less_than: 24

checks.name: Metric meets threshold
checks.definition:
filter: status <> 'cancelled'
checks:
- expression: sum(amount) / count(*)
  threshold:
    must_be_greater_than: 0
